boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Pittsburgh-Pittsburgh Campus
boards.description: Ten currently documented late-night destinations in and around Pitt’s Oakland campus, including food, study, and practical stops.

cards.title: El Jefe's Taqueria
cards.subtitle: 3807 Forbes Ave, Oakland
cards.notes: Use the Forbes Avenue counter-service location when you need a food option well after most campus-area kitchens have closed.
cards.short_summary: A Forbes Avenue taqueria with daily 4 a.m. hours.
cards.evidence_claim: El Jefe's official Pittsburgh page lists 3807 Forbes Ave and says it is open 8 a.m.–4 a.m., seven days a week.
cards.access_notes: Officially listed daily hours are 8 a.m.–4 a.m.; confirm service availability before leaving.

cards.title: Pitts Halal Brothers
cards.subtitle: 424 Semple St, South Oakland
cards.notes: Head to Semple Street for a late meal; the restaurant’s own page posts closing times through 3 a.m. on most days.
cards.short_summary: A South Oakland halal-food counter with very late posted hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Pitts Halal Brothers lists its address as 424 Semple Street and posts 3 a.m. closing times Monday through Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: 2 p.m.–3 a.m. Tuesday–Saturday; Monday has a midnight–3 a.m. period and 2 p.m.–3 a.m. service.

cards.title: Ocha Thai Noodle
cards.subtitle: 422 Semple St, South Oakland
cards.notes: Check the day before walking over: Ocha’s official schedule varies by day, with later Thursday through Saturday closing times.
cards.short_summary: Thai noodles on Semple Street with posted late-week 2 a.m. service.
cards.evidence_claim: Ocha Thai Noodle’s official site lists 422 Semple St and hours until 2 a.m. Thursday through Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official schedule lists 2 a.m. closing Thursday–Saturday, 1 a.m. Monday/Wednesday/Sunday, and Tuesday closed.

cards.title: Raising Cane's on Fifth
cards.subtitle: 3610 Fifth Ave, Oakland
cards.notes: Use the Fifth Avenue location for a documented midnight option on most nights, with an extra hour posted late in the week.
cards.short_summary: Chicken-finger meals near campus with midnight-to-1-a.m. hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Raising Cane’s lists its Fifth Avenue restaurant at 3610 Fifth Ave and posts closing at midnight Sunday–Wednesday and 1 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official restaurant hours are until midnight Sunday–Wednesday and until 1 a.m. Thursday–Saturday; dine-in and drive-through times are separately listed.

cards.title: Layne's Chicken Fingers
cards.subtitle: 3621 Forbes Ave, Oakland
cards.notes: Plan around the day of week: the Forbes Avenue location posts midnight closing most nights and 3 a.m. Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.short_summary: A Forbes Avenue chicken-fingers stop with 3 a.m. weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Layne’s lists its Pittsburgh Forbes location at 3621 Forbes Ave and posts 3 a.m. closing on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours are until midnight Sunday–Thursday and until 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Pizza Pronto Oakland
cards.subtitle: 4611 Centre Ave, North Oakland
cards.notes: Keep this Centre Avenue pizza shop in mind for a later pickup; its official contact page posts midnight and 1 a.m. closing times.
cards.short_summary: North Oakland pizza with midnight hours and a later weekend close.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Pronto’s official contact page lists the Oakland location at 4611 Centre Ave and hours until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Business hours listed by the restaurant are 10 a.m.–midnight Monday–Thursday and Sunday, and 10 a.m.–1 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Hillman Library
cards.subtitle: 3960 Forbes Ave, Pitt campus
cards.notes: Bring a valid Pitt ID for overnight entry and use the library’s study spaces during its academic-year extended-access schedule.
cards.short_summary: Pitt’s principal library offers 24/5 access during the academic year.
cards.evidence_claim: Pitt Libraries states that Hillman Library is open 24/5 during the academic year and 24/7 during each semester’s final two weeks.
cards.access_notes: During 11 p.m.–7 a.m. access, a valid Pitt ID is required; extended schedules are tied to the academic calendar.

cards.title: Forbes Semple Garage
cards.subtitle: 210 Meyran Ave, Oakland
cards.notes: Use this map-listed Oakland garage when a late return needs a documented all-night parking facility near Forbes and Semple.
cards.short_summary: A Public Parking Authority garage open around the clock.
cards.evidence_claim: The Pittsburgh Parking Authority lists Forbes Semple Garage at 210 Meyran Ave and says it is open 24 hours a day, seven days a week.
cards.access_notes: The Pittsburgh Parking Authority states the garage is open 24 hours daily; parking rates apply.

cards.title: A&K Convenience Store
cards.subtitle: 3459 Ward St, Oakland
cards.notes: For an all-night practical stop, verify stock on arrival and keep the Ward Street address handy rather than relying on a general search.
cards.short_summary: A Ward Street convenience store listed as open 24 hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Apple Maps lists A&K Convenience Store at 3459 Ward St in Oakland with hours marked open 24 hours every day.
cards.access_notes: Apple Maps currently lists the store as open 24 hours every day; verify directly if making a special trip.

cards.title: Primanti Bros. Oakland
cards.subtitle: 3803 Forbes Ave, Oakland
cards.notes: Choose the Oakland restaurant for a Forbes Avenue meal with midnight hours; use its location page to confirm the current schedule.
cards.short_summary: A Forbes Avenue restaurant with daily midnight posted closing.
cards.evidence_claim: Primanti Bros.’ official Oakland location page lists 3803 Forbes Ave and posts midnight closing every day of the week.
cards.access_notes: Official location hours currently run to 12 a.m. daily; this card is for restaurant dining, not alcohol-focused activity.
